allowed: The Kang2026 full primary source was audited before performance and its FAS, virtual-constraint, cascade, swing-suppression, and DOB structure was adapted to the common five-link acceleration interface.
The best V7 Kang2026 adaptation was safe and acquired faster than Full-LQR on the few successful Development samples, but failed the preregistered strong-baseline gate.
No V7 Paper candidate qualified on Development, so the locked V7 Holdout was not executed.
The frozen V5 SATC Overall Holdout claim remains unchanged.
